answer.text: Park the motorcycle upright on a level surface.
Start the engine from cold, let it idle for 2 to 3 minutes, then stop it.
Wait 2 to 3 minutes for the oil to settle, then read the sight glass.
The oil level should be close to the MAX mark.
If it is not, top up the oil to MAX and repeat the procedure.

policy.text: Do not fill the oil above the MAX mark, as overfilling may affect clutch function.
